description: Human-review storyboard contract for the v1 customer confirmation PDF flow. Blueprint compilation is intentionally deferred until customer approval.

sourceOfTruthPolicy.customerPdf: customer-storyboard.pdf is a presentation artifact only. It must be regenerated from storyboard-ai data and must not become the machine source of truth.
sourceOfTruthPolicy.v1Path: static customer materials -> evidence-ir -> storyboard-ai -> customer-storyboard.pdf
sourceOfTruthPolicy.futureMachinePath: after customer approval, storyboard-ai can be projected into storyboard-ir/specs/source-scene-ir
sourceOfTruthPolicy.approval: Approved phase text and images are locked by semanticHash before any future Blueprint/Luna build.

phaseCountPolicy.note: These are runtime/customer confirmation phases, not pipeline stages.

qualityRules: phase ids should be sequential as phase1..phaseN
non-final phases must not use CTA or click-to-advance semantics
final phase should close with CTA or a CTA-ready scene
each phase should have one primary target or a clear reason for observe/wait
consecutive phases should not share the same primary gameplay target unless the action semantics differ visibly
each customer PDF row must contain one large AI-generated image or a generated-image placeholder tied to visualBrief/sourceEvidence in dry-run mode
